project_type: React Native Expo mobile weather application
build_system: Expo CLI with Metro bundler, managed workflow
test_framework: Jest with React Native Testing Library (configured but tests run after npm install)
build_command: npx expo export (requires npm install first - not available in current network mode)
test_command: npm test (requires npm install first - not available in current network mode)
verification_instructions: Since INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode prevents npm install, verification is limited to: 1) TypeScript/JSX syntax correctness via file inspection, 2) Consistent imports and file structure, 3) All referenced files exist. Full verification requires npm install on a machine with internet.
setup_instructions: 1. Clone repo, 2. Run npm install (requires internet), 3. Run npx expo start, 4. Use Expo Go app on phone or emulator to preview
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - cannot install npm packages, cannot reach external APIs, cannot run build/test commands. All code must be written as source files ready for later installation. Node.js v22 is available but has a preload module issue preventing execution.
contribution_requirements: Work on feature branch, create PR against main. Clean commit history.
key_patterns: Expo managed workflow, file-based routing with expo-router, TypeScript throughout, functional components with hooks, context API for state management, service layer for API calls
directory_structure: Root: config files (package.json, tsconfig, babel, app.json). src/: main source code. src/screens/: screen components. src/components/: reusable UI components. src/services/: API service layer. src/context/: React context providers. src/hooks/: custom hooks. src/types/: TypeScript type definitions. src/constants/: app constants (colors, API config). src/navigation/: navigation configuration. assets/: images and fonts.
